title: keel release feed, schema version 1
description: release.json at the keel repo root. Generated by scripts/release.mjs from CHANGELOG.md on every release; never edited by hand. Stability: fields are only added within schemaVersion 1 (consumers must ignore unknown fields); removing or changing the meaning of a field bumps schemaVersion and the file name of this schema.

version.description: Latest release; equals plugin.json version and versions[0].version.

date.description: Release date (YYYY-MM-DD) from the CHANGELOG heading.

summary.description: One paragraph, plain text: the entry's lead paragraph, else its first highlights joined.

highlights.description: Bold lead phrases of the entry's bullets ("- **X** …"), in order.

compareUrl.description: GitHub compare from the previous version's tag; null if either tag does not exist.

commands.description: Claude Code slash commands, run in order, for a first install.

requirements.description: Minimum requirements, human-readable values keyed by tool.

notes.description: The entry body as Markdown (GitHub-flavoured), verbatim from CHANGELOG.md.
